headline: Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements, personal property abatements, and a 3ABC application at two meetings.
summary: The Board of Assessors held two meetings, one on July 07, 2026 and one on July 10, 2026. At the July 07 meeting, the board approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for two weeks, approved a 3ABC application, and approved three audited personal property abatements. At the July 10 meeting, the board approved three more personal property abatements.
decisions: Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for the week of June 15 to June 19 by signatures.
Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements for the week of June 22 to June 26 by signatures.
Approved three audited Personal Property Abatements by signatures.
Granted three Personal Property abatements, approved by signatures.

decision_evidence.quote: Week of June 15 to June 19 – Approved by signatures
Week of June 22 to June 26 – Approved by signatures
1 3ABC application was approved – R. Rondeau made a motion, A. Lombardo 2nd
3 audited Personal Property Abatements were approved by signatures
3 Personal Property were granted – approved by signatures
